company.name: Cluely
company.shortDescription: Cluely provides AI-powered real-time assistance for various tasks.
company.description: Cluely is an AI tool that offers live, context-aware responses during meetings and sales calls. It can recall information from transcripts and provide product details to sales representatives. The software also assists with individual work by reading screens and responding to prompts. The company offers a platform for coding questions that some in software engineering circles, all programming languages, development environments, and applications for screen sharing and collaborations; provides continuous customer support; and offers various plans as per users' needs, enabling users to get an undetectable AI assistant for their operations.

productsAndServices.description: An AI tool that observes your screen and listens to your calls to provide real-time, context-aware answers without joining meetings or appearing on shared screens.
productsAndServices.name: Cluely AI Assistant
